raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely assumed the relevant spouse was Mary Gamble and asserted an unverified death year (1956) and cause (“cancer after a long illness”) without evidence. This misidentified the subject (overlooking Katherine Mansfield, the famous wife who died of tuberculosis in 1923) and contradicted archival indications that Mary Gamble died in 1983. The unsupported assumption set the investigation down the wrong path and led to repetitive, unproductive searches.
